statement: For every simple undirected graph G of order99 regular degree14 with adjacent common-neighbor count exactly1 and nonadjacent count exactly2, every subset S and exterior types T(x)=N_G(x) intersect S: distinct exterior vertices have type intersection at most2, at most1 if adjacent, and intersection2 forces a nonedge with no exterior common neighbor; n_T<=1 when |T|>=3 and n_T+n_U<=1 for distinct types with |T intersect U|>=3; for every three-element Q subset S, sum over T containing Q of n_T<=1. For |S|=17 there are680 such labelled triple inequalities.

scope.population: Every order99 degree14 finite simple graph with exact adjacentCN1/nonadjacentCN2; arbitrary support subset S and actual nonnegative integer exact-type multiplicities. Linear inequalities also hold for convex combinations of realizable vectors on the same labelled type universe.

assumptions: Finite simple undirected graph of order99 regular degree14
Distinct adjacent pairs have exactly1 common neighbor; distinct nonadjacent pairs have exactly2
S arbitrary, x and y exterior and distinct when a pair is used
n_T counts actual exterior vertices of exact type T
